== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Dagobah-D-punishingone-PC-Errata-2017-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Punishing One (PC Errata 2013 slip)]] (16 April 2013): Same words. The black strip now has only the white italic “E”, no title.

The 2013 slip and the 2017 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
